call_path_audit.interpretation: The experiment does not assume this proves all runtime independence; forward-state parity is tested dynamically below.

interpretation.external_exact: If exact external lookup remains parity-exact, Ghost can keep its current exact-forever recall contract while bounding the active tier, but total archival storage remains intentionally unbounded.
interpretation.finite_horizon: If all forward/restart/recent/ambiguous behavior gates remain exact, then deleting ancient exact payloads does not damage ordinary ongoing continuity in this workload. The measurable loss is explicit access to expired episode payloads and affect-bearing recall of a unique ancient episode.

next_falsification_target: HORIZON VALUE ADJUDICATION + EXPLICIT EXPIRED-RECALL API SEMANTICS BEFORE ANY PRODUCTION MUTATION
non_claim: Phase 1S does not choose a retention horizon, change the public API, or authorize deletion in production. It tests whether the Phase-1Q/1R gap propagates into ordinary forward continuity under a deterministic long trace.
